title: ClinEdge: An Expert-Graded Benchmark of Real Patient Edge Cases Where Frontier Multimodal Models Fail
abstract: arXiv:2610.15239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most benchmarks for large language models in medicine are built from licensing examinations and theoretical questions. The few that draw on real clinical data do so only in part, and rarely require a model to read a patient's own imaging. ClinEdge addresses this gap with 32 real, de-identified patient cases from active clinical practice, each evaluated across seven frontier systems for a total of 224 expert-graded evaluations. Each case pairs primary imaging with a short vignette, contains a feature known to defeat pattern-matched reasoning, and is scored against the patient's documented clinical course. The suite is built for depth rather than volume. Grading followed a two-stage expert process. translated_title: ClinEdge：一个由专家评分的真实患者边缘病例基准测试——前沿多模态模型在此类病例上失败
translated_abstract: 医学领域的大语言模型基准测试大多基于执业资格考试和理论问题构建。少数利用真实临床数据的基准也仅部分采用此类数据，且极少要求模型阅读患者自身的影像资料。ClinEdge 填补了这一空白：它包含来自活跃临床实践的 32 个真实、去标识化患者病例，每个病例均在七个前沿系统上进行评估，共计 224 次专家评分评估。每个病例将主要影像与简短的临床情景描述相结合，包含一个已知能够挫败模式匹配推理的特征，并根据患者记录的实际临床病程进行评分。该测试集追求深度而非数量。评分采用两阶段专家流程：首先，一位资深骨科医生根据加权评分表和通过/不通过判定对所有 224 个回复进行评分；其次，由十九名医生（大多为医学院教学医院的高级专科医生）组成的专家组独立审查每个病例
tldr: ClinEdge 基于来自真实临床实践的 32 个去标识化患者边缘病例构建专家评分基准，通过影像与两阶段专家评审系统揭示了前沿多模态大模型在复杂真实临床场景中的失败之处。
en_tdlr: ClinEdge is an expert-graded benchmark built from 32 real, de-identified patient edge cases with imaging and a two-stage expert review process, systematically exposing where frontier multimodal models fail in complex real-world clinical scenarios.
